products.text:
Type: tufted boxy accent armchair
Use: lounging, reading; living room, bedroom
Style: mid-century modern, contemporary, glam
Materials: woven upholstery fabric, piped edges, brass-finished metal hairpin sled legs
Colors: warm grey-green, soft gold
Shape: square boxy frame, flat track arms level with button-tufted back, loose seat cushion, thin angled metal sled legs, roomy but light on its legs
Feel: tailored, refined, airy
Goes with: brass accents, walnut, cream walls, sage tones; mid-century or modern glam living rooms

Type: adjustable chaise lounge chair
Use: sunbathing, lounging outdoors; patio, poolside, deck
Style: contemporary, minimalist, modern
Materials: dark powder-coated metal frame, thick upholstered outdoor cushion
Colors: dark bronze brown, warm beige
Shape: long low frame, reclining adjustable back, slim straight legs with stretchers, narrow armrests, thick piped cushion, long and open
Feel: relaxed, clean, resort-like
Goes with: stone patios, neutral outdoor fabrics, dark metal furniture; modern outdoor spaces

Type: upholstered accent armchair
Use: lounging, reading; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: mid-century modern, contemporary, modern
Materials: textured woven fabric, chrome metal legs
Colors: dark charcoal grey, silver
Shape: sloped flared track arms, two-button tufted loose back cushion, deep seat, slim tapered metal legs, compact and clean-lined
Feel: sleek, understated, cozy
Goes with: white walls, chrome or glass, light wood, cool greys; modern or mid-century living rooms

Type: wooden slat rocking chair
Use: rocking, relaxing outdoors; porch, patio
Style: farmhouse, traditional, rustic
Materials: solid hardwood, stained finish
Colors: dark brown
Shape: tall slatted back with curved top rail, scrolled armrests, flat wooden seat, turned legs, curved rockers, upright and open
Feel: homey, nostalgic, relaxed
Goes with: white porches, plants, natural wood, plaid cushions; farmhouse or cottage spaces

Type: two-seat reclining sofa
Use: lounging, watching TV, napping; living room, family room
Style: contemporary, traditional
Materials: soft microfiber-like fabric, padded channel cushioning, side recline lever
Colors: warm mocha taupe
Shape: plush biscuit-tufted high back, padded pillow-top rolled arms, two reclining seats, low skirted base, bulky and overstuffed
Feel: cozy, plush, comfortable
Goes with: beige walls, light wood floors, jute rugs, warm neutrals; casual family living rooms

Type: high-back swivel desk chair
Use: working at a desk; home office, bedroom
Style: contemporary, modern, minimalist
Materials: upholstered fabric shell, chrome five-star base, casters, gas lift
Colors: warm cream beige, silver chrome, black
Shape: tall curved shell back with stitched panels, low wrap-around arms, padded seat, swivel pedestal with rolling star base, slim and compact
Feel: soft, clean, polished
Goes with: white desks, light wood, brass or chrome accents; modern home offices

Type: striped rolled-arm armchair
Use: lounging, reading; living room, bedroom
Style: traditional, coastal, classic
Materials: striped cotton-like upholstery fabric, dark wood tapered legs
Colors: cream white, light grey stripes, dark espresso
Shape: rounded tight back, scrolled rolled arms, deep seat, wide vertical stripes, short tapered dark legs, medium and generous
Feel: fresh, relaxed, inviting
Goes with: white walls, navy or grey accents, natural wood; coastal or classic living rooms

Type: leather push-back recliner
Use: reclining, reading, watching TV; living room, den, home office
Style: traditional, classic
Materials: top-grain leather, brass nailhead trim, wood legs
Colors: dark reddish brown, antique brass
Shape: tight high back, rolled arms with nailhead outlines, cushioned seat, short tapered wood legs, compact and solid
Feel: rich, cozy, distinguished
Goes with: dark wood, plaid textiles, warm walls, library shelving; traditional dens or studies

Type: wingback accent chair
Use: reading, sitting; living room, bedroom
Style: traditional, classic, contemporary
Materials: woven upholstery fabric, dark nailhead trim, dark wood legs
Colors: warm oatmeal beige, dark brown
Shape: tall wingback with flared wings, nailhead-lined edges, loose seat cushion, slim tapered dark legs, upright and elegant
Feel: refined, warm, stately
Goes with: dark wood, leather, warm neutrals, brass lamps; classic or transitional living rooms

Type: oversized lounge armchair
Use: lounging, curling up; living room, family room
Style: contemporary, modern
Materials: tweed upholstery, loose back cushions, small dark wood feet
Colors: warm greige tweed, dark brown
Shape: deep wide seat, sloped scooped arms, loose back and lumbar pillows, low hidden feet, oversized and low
Feel: cozy, relaxed, enveloping
Goes with: warm neutrals, textured throws, light oak, linen; casual modern living rooms
